name: Moore's Machine
source:
Moore's Machine features a scientist named Dr. Moore, who gets a little more than he bargained for when he makes an unusual request of an AI.

This visual novel has mild language, and might not be suitable for younger people.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160708122543/http://www.thebeeskneesstories.com:80/portfolio/moores-machine/]Official site[/url]]
